name: Microsoft-Nebius New Jersey

timeline.event: Land clearing begins for northern two buildings (Building 1-2).

explain: Microsoft-Nebius New Jersey is an operating AI data center in Vineland, NJ, owned by nebius and used by microsoft. Epoch AI estimates it draws 50 MW today and 70 MW when finished.
